user.title: Log in with your Decathlon account
user.description:
1. Open the [Decathlon login page]({url}) and log in with your Decathlon account.
2. After logging in you land on a page saying **"Whoops! Looks like something went wrong"**. This is expected: the login worked.
3. Click in the browser's address bar and copy the **full** address. It starts with `{redirect_prefix}`. Some browsers hide everything after `/redirect` until you click into the address bar.

Then select **Submit** and paste the address in the next step. The code in it expires after a few minutes.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in again
reauth_confirm.description:
Decathlon Geocover rejected the stored login, so you need to log in again.

1. Open the [Decathlon login page]({url}) and log in with your Decathlon account.
2. After logging in you land on a page saying **"Whoops! Looks like something went wrong"**. This is expected: the login worked.
3. Click in the browser's address bar and copy the **full** address. It starts with `{redirect_prefix}`. Some browsers hide everything after `/redirect` until you click into the address bar.

Then select **Submit** and paste the address in the next step. The code in it expires after a few minutes.

paste.title: Paste the address
paste.description: Paste the full address of the "Whoops!" page. If the code has expired, [open the login page again]({url}) and copy the new address.

error.invalid_url: This address has no login code, or it belongs to a different login attempt. Copy the full address of the "Whoops!" page, including everything after /redirect.
error.code_rejected: The login code was rejected; it has probably expired. Open the login page again and paste the new address straight away.
error.invalid_auth: Geocover rejected the login. Open the login page again and paste the new address.

abort.already_configured: This Decathlon account is already configured
abort.wrong_account: You logged in with a different Decathlon account. Log in with the account this entry was set up with.
abort.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Geocover login service

data_description.scan_interval: How often to fetch data from Geocover, in minutes. The bike's 2G module only reports in every so often, so polling faster than it reports won't give fresher data.

auth_failed.message: Geocover rejected the stored login; log in again.
